0:
port: 80
host: "0.0.0.0"
rate_limit_rps: 10
max_upload_mb: 10240
chunk_size_mb: 5
mount_points:
  - name: "Users"
    path: "/mnt/tscibilia"
    read_only: false
  - name: "System"
    path: "/mnt/system"
    read_only: false
  - name: "Docs"
    path: "/mnt/docs"
    read_only: false
  - name: "Lightroom"
    path: "/mnt/lightroom"
    read_only: false
  - name: "Strata"
    path: "/mnt/strata"
    read_only: false
  - name: "Grey"
    path: "/mnt/grey"
    read_only: false

[INPUT]
  name              kubernetes_events
  tag               k8s_events
  kube_url          https://kubernetes.default.svc:443
  kube_ca_file      /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
  kube_token_file   /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token

[FILTER]
  name    grep
  match   k8s_events
  exclude message already present on machine

[OUTPUT]
  name              http
  match             k8s_events
  host              victoria-logs-server.monitoring.svc.cluster.local
  port              9428
  uri               /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=type,reason&_msg_field=message&_time_field=date
  format            json_lines
  json_date_format  iso8601
  compress          gzip
